title: QUIC Version Negotiation Runner Verification
verification_method: Requirement-home tests, helper dry-run planning, a local interop run, and artifact inspection.
preconditions: The repo-local interop helper can be executed in dry-run mode.
The local machine can supply the harness certificate override used by the process-level requirement-home test.
scope: Verify that the harness accepts versionnegotiation on both client and server roles, routes it through the reserved-version runner path from the documented root REQUESTS URL, and keeps the major-peer matrix unchanged.
procedure: Run `dotnet test tests\Incursa.Quic.Tests\Incursa.Quic.Tests.csproj -c Release -m:1 --filter "FullyQualifiedName~REQ_QUIC_INT_0020|FullyQualifiedName~REQ_QUIC_RFC9000_0901"` and confirm the positive and negative requirement-home tests pass.
Run `dotnet build benchmarks\Incursa.Quic.Benchmarks.csproj -c Release` as supporting evidence for the slice.
Run `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\interop\Invoke-QuicInteropRunner.ps1 -DryRun -TestCases versionnegotiation` and confirm the helper plan classifies the testcase as supported/executed.
Run one real local interop invocation for `versionnegotiation` and confirm both harness roles complete with the expected reserved-version and version-negotiation markers.
Inspect the resulting stdout, stderr, and runner artifacts for source-backed proof that the testcase uses the reserved client version and the documented root request target.
expected_result: The harness supports versionnegotiation on both roles through the reserved-version runner path, the helper inventory remains source-backed, and the major-peer matrix profile remains unchanged.
status_summary: The slice is complete: the reserved-version runner contract is source-backed, the focused requirement-home tests passed, and the live local interop runner completed successfully with preserved evidence under artifacts/interop-runner/20260512-170806170-both-quic-go/.

supplemental_sections.heading: Deferred Coverage
supplemental_sections.content: `versionnegotiation` is now source-backed as a harness testcase with live runner proof, but it remains outside the major peer matrix by profile choice. `http3`, `zerortt`, `chacha20`, `v2`, `rebind-port`, `rebind-addr`, and `connectionmigration` remain outside this verification.
